appSetting.description: This module should be turned off in production environments
appSetting.warning: Adjusting the configuration here is only temporarily effective. To truly apply it to the project, click the 「 @:app.layouts.appSetting.copy 」 button and paste it into the {path} file.

theme.title: Theme
theme.syncTip: Switching color schemes will share the same base color and theme color

menu.title: Navigation Bar
menu.darkTip: Navigation bar dark mode only works when color scheme is light mode

mainMenuClickMode.title: Click Main Navigation
mainMenuClickMode.tip: In smart mode, the default operation is to switch. When there is only one accessible navigation in the sub-navigation, the jump operation is performed.

subMenuAutoCollapse.title: Auto Collapse Sub Navigation
subMenuAutoCollapse.tip: When sub navigation is collapsed, it will temporarily expand when hovering with the mouse

switchTabbarAndToolbar.title: Display Switch
switchTabbarAndToolbar.tip: Switch the display order of tab bar and tool bar

tip.constant: @:app.layouts.appSetting.tabbar.minMaxWidth.constant : Adaptive within the set range, when the minimum and maximum values are the same, it is fixed width
tip.adaptive-min: @:app.layouts.appSetting.tabbar.minMaxWidth.adaptive-min : Adaptive within the set range (with minimum width)
tip.adaptive-max: @:app.layouts.appSetting.tabbar.minMaxWidth.adaptive-max : Adaptive within the set range (with maximum width)

memory.title: Memory Function
memory.tip: Non-pinned and non-resident tabs will always exist in this session window, and will not be lost when refreshing the browser or re-logging in

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.tip: You can add commonly used navigation to favorites

pageReload.title: Page Reload
pageReload.tip: Reload the current page without refreshing the browser

progress.title: Loading Progress Bar
progress.tip: A progress bar will be displayed at the top of the page when routing, this progress is only a simulation effect, not the actual loading progress

dynamicTitle.title: Dynamic Title
dynamicTitle.tip: When enabled, the page title will show the current route title in the format "Page Title - Website Name"; when disabled, it displays the website name, which is configured in the .env.* file in the project root directory

watermark.title: Watermark
watermark.tip: The watermark display content is configured in the src/store/modules/app/watermark.ts file

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.tip: Allows users to submit feedback, specific business code needs to be supplemented in src/components/AppAccountButton/feedback.vue

mobile.title: Mobile Access
mobile.tip: After closing, mobile access will be disabled

enable.title: Enable
enable.tip: After logging in, the default entry is the homepage, otherwise the default entry is the first navigation page

homeTitle.title: Title
homeTitle.tip: When internationalization is enabled, this setting is invalid
